description: This file contains utility functions for evaluating telemetry thresholds, sending email notifications, and anomaly detection for devices within a device telemetry management platform. It includes functions that interact with services such as Firestore and email, and defines logic to evaluate rules and detect anomalies asynchronously.

methods.name: bool _compare(op: str, val: float, threshold: float)
methods.description: Compares a value against a threshold based on an operator (gt, gte, lt, lte, eq, ne).

methods.name: _maybe_notify_email(user_email: str, message: str)
methods.description: Sends an email notification asynchronously to a specified user email.

methods.name: evaluate_thresholds_for_device(device_id: str, ts: int, metrics: Dict[str, float])
methods.description: Evaluates threshold rules for a specific device and sends alerts if conditions are met, optionally notifying users via email.

methods.name: periodic_anomaly_check()
methods.description: Runs anomaly detection across devices, flagging significant deviations in telemetry metrics.

ctags.name: _compare
ctags.pattern: /^def _compare(op: str, val: float, threshold: float) -> bool:$/

ctags.name: evaluate_thresholds_for_device
ctags.pattern: /^async def evaluate_thresholds_for_device(device_id: str, ts: int, metrics: Dict[str, float]):$/
ctags.signature: (device_id: str, ts: int, metrics: Dict[str, float])
